comment: Scheduled Service development route. FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m03-scheduled-service.json, FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/m03-scheduled-service.json. Real human input, ordinary health, discovery supplies, authoritative enemies and mast shots. No grants or teleports. Accurate aim proves authoring, not fresh-player acceptance or ten-minute pacing.

states.name: yard_arrival
states.note: The daylight arrival frames the open loading-car frontage and platform guards. This still does not establish distant-mast visibility.

states.name: yard_rifle
states.note: Collect the guaranteed Rifle, finite bullets and armor before entering the first guard zone. The schedule names Low Water.

states.name: platform_guards
states.note: Two Clerks and two Sweepers guard the first loading car. The named crew must fall before its optional release.

states.name: platform_car_release
states.note: Entering the cleared car platform releases its two captives through the server-owned optional car state. This car does not gate departure.

states.name: solo_jammer_observation
states.note: Observe the isolated transmitter from an open dodge lane. This timed strip provides context; the following combat probe explicitly waits for and captures the first resolved enemy firing phase.

states.name: solo_jammer_defeat
states.note: Sidestep the committed pulse and defeat the isolated Jammer with normal Rifle ammunition.

states.name: roof_stairs
states.note: Climb six authoritative 0.5 metre steps to the carriage roof and collect roof bullets. No ladder, jump grant or camera relocation substitutes for movement.

states.name: roof_mixed_pressure
states.note: The rooftop Jammer and two Sweepers pressure the car crossing. Ordinary input evades their committed tells, with surface checks before strafing. The following ordinary drop-and-flank route can also continue from an actual ground pose after combat.

states.name: roof_ground_flank
states.note: Leave the carriage route through an ordinary drop into the central ground lane, or continue from the actual ground pose after combat. Cross south of the cars, then defeat the remaining roof-group Sweeper from the open western flank. The earlier ascent proves the real roof stairs; this transition does not claim a stair descent.

states.name: siding_optional_guards
states.note: Take the optional western siding fight. Its independent guards and liberation are unnecessary for the mast and train objectives.

states.name: siding_car_release
states.note: The second optional car releases after its own watch is defeated and the party enters its platform.

states.name: brakemen_hut
states.note: The hut gives a readable protected recovery stop with finite health, bullets and shells. The missing-morning proposal is not asserted here.

states.name: roof_car_release
states.note: The third car uses the already-cleared roof watch. Its release and nearby optional armor remain separate from the required route.

states.name: mast_guard_fight
states.note: The signal platform's Jammer and three Sweepers guard two ground approaches and the broad stair route to the pod precision position.

states.name: mast_precision_stairs
states.note: Reach the shoot objective on real stairs. The red transmitter pod is above the support column and within normal Rifle range.

states.name: mast_shutdown_shots
states.note: Hold the ordinary fire action on the cleared mast's 40 HP pod. Resolved server shots select the fallen world; a use command cannot disable it.

states.name: mast_fallen
states.note: The fallen pod and column rest on the signal-box roof. Collision changed before this presentation, while the yard remains connected.

states.name: signal_box_secret
states.note: An optional ordinary step route reaches the signal roof and secret bullets after shutdown without crossing the fallen collision volumes.

states.name: train_final_push
states.note: Two Clerks, four Sweepers and the fourth Jammer cover the locomotive. The known mast-west corridor and low ground crossover stay south of the train activation boundary, then ordinary movement enters the western recovery and combat approach.

states.name: train_boarding
states.note: The train remains stationary until a deliberate local use with the living ready party inside the boarding region.

states.name: train_departure
states.note: Use the locomotive control through ordinary input after mast shutdown and the final watch. The server records departure and optional liberation separately.
